works: Global shortcut set on window keydown (⌘K palette, ⌘T/⌘W/⌘⇧T tabs, ⌘1-9/0, Ctrl(+Shift)+Tab cycle, ⌘E explain, ⌘S dual save/commit-preview, ⌘I inspector, ⌘⇧D discard-all, ⌘R schema refresh, ⌘⇧F schema filter) with e.defaultPrevented dedupe against CodeMirror
Centralized escStack (src/app/overlay/escStack.ts): one capture-phase listener, topmost-overlay-only Esc + onKey — stacked modals can't both act on one keystroke
Shared overlay primitive (Overlay.tsx): portal-to-body, outside-click, viewport clamp with edge-flip, measured via offsetWidth so entrance springs don't skew position
ContextMenu primitive: one-level submenu, full arrow-key nav, disabled/danger/hint support, focusless mousedown to dodge WKWebView focus quirks
Palette (cmdk): actions, appearance, tables, connections, history with 120ms-debounced sqlite-backed search; ⌘K toggles open/closed
Theme engine: seed palettes → full CSS-var token set, custom themes synthesize the opposite light/dark variant, applied at module import (no flash), system-mode media-query listener
CloseGuard flow: every tab-close routes through request(); commit-and-close keeps tab open on commit failure
ConnToast: global connect-failure toast with profile name + Edit action, 8s auto-dismiss, selectable error text
noAutocorrect: stamps autocorrect/autocapitalize/spellcheck off on every current+future field (kills WKWebView 'Fifth' substitution in SQL fields)

Floating-card shell: vibrancy gutters, drag-region titlebar, animated breadcrumb, prod red strip, inspector width resize + persist (zustand persist), never-zero-tabs invariant, ⌘⇧T closed-tab stack (20 deep)

gaps.title: Global shortcuts fire behind open modals; overlay z-index contradicts esc-stack order
gaps.detail: App.tsx:104-179 window keydown handler has no overlay-awareness: with Palette/DangerModal/CloseGuardModal open, ⌘W/⌘T/⌘1-9/Ctrl+Tab/⌘E/⌘S/⌘R all act on the hidden surface (⌘W while CloseGuardModal is open overwrites closeGuard.pending — the first close request is silently dropped, closeGuard.ts:22; ⌘S while CloseGuard is open stacks an EditPreview; ⌘E runs EXPLAIN behind a destructive confirm). Worse, ⌘K opens the Palette (pal-backdrop z-40, palette.css:4) UNDER a DangerModal (danger-backdrop z-50, app.css:29) — the palette is invisible but topmost in escStack, so it silently steals Esc and all keys. Fix: export depth() from escStack.ts and early-return in App's onKey when depth>0; make Overlay assign z-index from stack position instead of per-callsite CSS so paint order always matches key order.

gaps.title: ⌘Enter/⌘. only exist inside CodeMirror + no focus restore on overlay close — keyboard flow breaks constantly
gaps.detail: Run and Cancel are bound only in the editor keymap (SqlEditor.tsx:51,63). Focus in the grid, sidebar, or on <body> (which is where focus lands after EVERY overlay closes — Modal never restores focus to the invoker, Overlay.tsx:41) means ⌘Enter does nothing and — critically — ⌘. cannot cancel a runaway query without first mousing into the editor. 'The grid is the app' but you can't re-run or cancel from the grid. Fix: add app-level fallback ⌘Enter→run(editorRunText.current?.()) and ⌘.→cancel in App.tsx onKey; store document.activeElement on pushOverlay and restore it on close; add ⌘L (or similar) to focus the editor. Cross-pane focus model is [known] v0.45 but the run/cancel fallback + focus restore is a 20-line fix needed now.

gaps.title: App.tsx re-renders the entire shell tree on every editor keystroke
gaps.detail: App.tsx:52 subscribes with s.tabs.find(t=>t.id===s.activeId) which returns a fresh object identity on every keystroke (tabs.ts:231-241 remaps the active tab on each setSql), so App — and with it TabBar, ResultsPane/grid subtree, SchemaTree, ConnectionRail — reconciles per keystroke. With a 50k-row/500-col result mounted this eats the <16ms typing budget. Same shape during inspector drag: inspectorWidth subscription (App.tsx:50) re-renders the tree per mousemove AND useInspector's persist middleware does a localStorage JSON write per mousemove (inspector.ts:40). Fix: select scalars only (activeId, kind, name, table ref) with useShallow; drive drag width via a CSS var on the DOM node + commit to store on mouseup.

gaps.title: ⌘Q / window close silently loses work — no CloseRequested guard, no persist flush
gaps.detail: Nothing handles window close: no onCloseRequested (src-tauri/src/lib.rs has no on_window_event) and no beforeunload. Quitting with uncommitted cell edits skips the CloseGuard entirely (it's only wired to tab-close, App.tsx:119-124) — staged edits vanish. Separately tabs persist() is debounced 600ms with no flush (tabs.ts:44-56): quit within 600ms of typing loses the last SQL edits. Directly violates 'never lose work'. Fix: getCurrentWindow().onCloseRequested → flush persist synchronously + if any byTab pending edits, preventDefault and show CloseGuard; also flush on visibilitychange/blur.

gaps.title: Palette caps tables at first 400 BEFORE filtering — most tables unfindable at scale
gaps.detail: Palette.tsx:208 snapshot.tables.slice(0,400) then lets cmdk filter the rendered 400. On a 50-schema / 2000-table DB (a large real-world shape), any table past index 400 in snapshot order can never be found via ⌘K — the palette lies by showing 'No results' for a table that exists. Fix: shouldFilter={false} for the tables group, run your own fuzzy match over ALL tables against query, render top ~50; same pattern keeps per-keystroke cost bounded.

gaps.title: No native macOS menu bar
gaps.detail: [known — ROADMAP v0.5 P0] Zero menus registered in lib.rs; Tauri's default menu gives bare Quit/Copy/Paste only. No About, no Preferences item, no File/Edit/View/Window/Help, and every custom shortcut (⌘T/⌘W/⌘K/⌘E/⌘I…) is undiscoverable — the single biggest 'not a real Mac app' tell vs TablePlus. Native menu accelerators would also fix the e.key layout-dependence (App.tsx:107 matching breaks on non-Latin keyboard layouts). Build Menu in Rust with accelerators emitting events the frontend already handles.

gaps.title: No Settings/Preferences surface (⌘, does nothing)
gaps.detail: [known — ROADMAP v0.5 P0] settings.ts only holds theme + fnInComplete (the latter reachable ONLY via editor right-click, SqlEditor.tsx:212). No home for row limit, statement timeout, NULL rendering, font size, confirm toggles, restore-tabs. Add a Settings modal on ⌘, + menu item, backed by the existing zustand persist store.

gaps.title: Palette command coverage ~30% of what the app can do
gaps.detail: Palette.tsx has 8 actions. Missing: switch-to-open-tab (can't jump between 10 tabs by name — table-stakes), close tab, rename tab, disconnect/reconnect, cancel running query, commit pending edits / discard edits, open table structure (only browse), open saved query, copy connection URI, new connection, toggle explain, clear filters. Also no keyboard-shortcut cheat-sheet anywhere (⌘/ overlay). [known partial — 'Palette: more commands' is v0.5 P2, but tab-switching belongs now]. Each command is ~5 lines against existing store actions.

gaps.title: Table-tab close guard ignores the browser draft row
gaps.detail: closeGuard.ts:15 counts only edits.byTab pending cell edits. A half-typed inline add-row (draftRow in useBrowser) is silently destroyed by ⌘W/tab close with no prompt — same 'never lose work' violation class the guard exists to prevent. Fix: pendingCount should also consult useBrowser draftRow for table tabs.

gaps.title: ⌘⇧D discard-all has zero confirmation and no undo
gaps.detail: App.tsx:161-166 discards every staged edit across the active tab instantly. One mistyped chord (⌘D duplicate-line is adjacent muscle memory) silently destroys possibly dozens of careful cell edits; edit undo/redo is [known] v0.45 but until then this needs a confirm modal or an in-toast 'Undo' holding the discarded snapshot.

gaps.title: CloseGuard: plain Enter = destructive discard
gaps.detail: CloseGuardModal.tsx:27-34 maps Enter→discard-and-close, ⌘Enter→commit. Enter as the destructive default inverts Mac convention (Return = safe/primary); a user hammering Enter to dismiss what they think is a notice loses edits. Make Enter=Keep (or commit), require an explicit key (⌘⌫ / click) for discard.

gaps.title: No general toast system — non-connect errors are swallowed silently
gaps.detail: Only connect failures surface (ConnToast). tabs_save/saved_upsert/history_clear/tabs persist are all fire-and-forget `void invoke` (tabs.ts:54, Palette.tsx:150) — if the appdb write fails, tabs/saved queries are lost on quit with zero warning. Single-slot error state: a second failure overwrites the first; ensureTabSession sets error without errorProfileId (connections.ts:171) so the toast loses its title context and Edit button. Fix: small toast queue store (info/warn/error), catch-path writes from every IPC call, hover-pauses the 8s timer, Esc dismisses (join escStack).

gaps.title: Missing standard macOS tab shortcuts
gaps.detail: App.tsx:132-140: only Ctrl+Tab and ⌘1-9/0 exist. Missing ⌘⇧[ / ⌘⇧] and ⌘⌥←/→ (the shortcuts Mac users actually use — Safari/Chrome/TablePlus/iTerm all honor them); ⌘0 goes to tab 10 instead of the Mac convention ⌘9 = last tab; Ctrl+Tab is positional, not MRU. Also no 'move tab left/right' (⌘⇧←/→ or drag already exists?).

gaps.title: ⌘⇧F is double-booked: schema filter today, SQL-format in the v0.5 plan
gaps.detail: App.tsx:141-144 binds ⌘⇧F to focus #schema-filter (and silently no-ops on the dashboard or when the element is missing). ROADMAP_v0.5.md's v0.5 gate says '⌘⇧F formats SQL'. Resolve now before muscle memory sets: convention is ⌘⇧F = format (VS Code), sidebar filter should be ⌘⇧E or via ⌘K. Also give the no-op case feedback.

gaps.title: Window size/position not persisted
gaps.detail: [known — v0.5 P1] tauri.conf.json hardcodes 1240×800; every launch forgets size/position/display. Add tauri-plugin-window-state (2 lines) — cheap, daily-felt.

gaps.title: Context menu primitive gaps: no max-height, no type-ahead, no checkbox items, no re-open on second right-click
gaps.detail: contextmenu.css has no max-height/overflow-y on .ctx-menu — a long menu (future schema-tree menus on 50-schema DBs) clamps to the top margin and its tail is unreachable off-screen. No type-ahead (typing 'c' should jump to Copy — native menus do), no Home/End, no checked/radio MenuNode kind (SqlEditor.tsx:212 fakes a toggle with 'ON/OFF' label text), right-click at a new spot while a menu is open just closes it (AnchoredOverlay layer swallows the event — native re-opens at the new point; forward contextmenu from the layer), and no re-clamp on window resize [known followup in ROADMAP].

gaps.title: Modal accessibility/focus basics absent
gaps.detail: Overlay.tsx Modal: no role=dialog/aria-modal, no focus trap (Tab walks into the obscured background — you can tab to and activate hidden buttons behind a DangerModal), no autofocus-first-focusable contract, no focus return on close. ContextMenu items are bare divs (no role=menu/menuitem, invisible to VoiceOver). Full screen-reader support is out-of-charter, but trap+restore+roles is ~40 lines in the shared primitive and fixes real keyboard bugs.

gaps.title: Escape during IME composition closes the overlay
gaps.detail: escStack.ts:18-28 doesn't check e.isComposing/keyCode 229. Typing Japanese/Chinese/Korean in the palette input or tab rename: Esc pressed to cancel the composition instead nukes the whole overlay (and preventDefault breaks the composition cancel). Guard: if (e.isComposing) return.

gaps.title: Window title / breadcrumb dead ends
gaps.detail: index.html title 'qwry' is never updated — ⌘Tab switcher, Mission Control, and screen-recording labels never show which connection/db you're on (dangerous when prod + staging windows look identical someday; the in-app crumb does but the OS surfaces don't). Breadcrumb is pointer-events:none (v2.css:28): clicking connection ⇒ dashboard, db ⇒ DbSwitcher, table ⇒ structure are all expected affordances. Sync document.title + window.setTitle from crumbs; make crumb segments clickable.

gaps.title: Palette 'Run query' ignores the editor selection
gaps.detail: Palette.tsx:99 calls useResults.run() (whole buffer) while ⌘↵ and the toolbar honor the selection via editorRunText (SqlEditor.tsx:33). Selecting one statement then running via palette executes EVERYTHING — on prod that's a correctness/safety divergence between two 'run' affordances. Route through editorRunText.current?.().

gaps.title: Palette items not state-aware; 'Clear history (all)' scope lie
gaps.detail: Run/Refresh schema/Save query/Clear history render enabled with no connection or empty tab — selecting them silently no-ops (Palette.tsx:99-172). Items need disabled state or hiding. 'Clear history (all)' only clears the ACTIVE profile [known — ROADMAP v0.35]. Also add per-item ⌘-hints consistently (Explain, Discard have none anywhere).

gaps.title: Corrupt stored custom theme bricks the whole UI at startup
gaps.detail: theme.ts hexToRgb/hexToHsl parseInt NaN on a malformed hex (hand-edited or corrupted qwry.settings localStorage, or a future schema change) → every derived CSS var becomes invalid → app paints with no backgrounds/text colors, at import time (settings.ts:101) before any UI exists to fix it. Validate palette shape on rehydrate; on any NaN fall back to DEFAULT_PALETTE.

gaps.title: No UI zoom (⌘+ / ⌘− / ⌘0)
gaps.detail: Every Mac app and every DB client has view zoom; qwry has none and no font-size pref (Settings gap). WKWebView zoom or a root font-size var scaled by shortcut; persists in settings. Matters daily on externals/projectors.

gaps.title: noAutocorrect MutationObserver scans every DOM insertion — taxes grid scroll
gaps.detail: noAutocorrect.ts:29-39 runs matches()+querySelectorAll('input, textarea, [contenteditable]') on every added element. The virtualized grid mounts/unmounts row nodes continuously during 60fps scroll, so this observer does per-frame selector work over row subtrees that contain no inputs. Fix: set the attributes in React (a shared <Input> or via editing-cell mount) and scope/disconnect the observer, or observe only shell containers.

gaps.title: ⌘W on the dashboard closes invisible work-view tabs
gaps.detail: App.tsx:119-124 runs closeGuard.request regardless of homeMode — on the connections dashboard ⌘W closes tabs you cannot see (recoverable via closedStack only if sql non-empty; table tabs are not remembered at all, tabs.ts:118-121). On home, ⌘W should no-op or close the window per Mac convention.

gaps.title: session-closed listener race / StrictMode leak
gaps.detail: App.tsx:95-102: if the effect cleans up before the dynamic import + listen() promise resolves, unlistenClosed is still undefined → listener leaks; under React StrictMode dev double-mount you get duplicate markDisconnected firings. Track a cancelled flag and unlisten inside the .then when cancelled.

gaps.title: Inspector resize: no pointer capture, no window-relative clamp
gaps.detail: App.tsx:76-88 uses window mousemove/mouseup — releasing the button outside the window (fast drag past screen edge) can strand 'resizing'. setWidth clamps 220-640 absolute (inspector.ts:40) but not against window width: 640 inspector + 248 sidebar at the 800px min window crushes the main card to ~0. Use setPointerCapture and clamp to a fraction of innerWidth.

gaps.title: ThemePicker keyboard + affordance gaps
gaps.detail: ThemePicker.tsx: swatch grid has no arrow-key navigation; the edit/duplicate affordance is a nested <span onClick> inside a <button> (ThemePicker.tsx:123-133) — not keyboard reachable and invalid interactive nesting; Delete theme is instant with no confirm/undo; draft color changes don't live-preview (must Save to see); no theme export/import. Also the titlebar theme button (App.tsx:200) has no aria-label and no shortcut.

gaps.title: DangerModal lacks keyboard confirm and severity tiers
gaps.detail: DangerModal.tsx: 'Run anyway' has no ⌘Enter binding (Modal onKey unused) — mouse-only confirm in a keyboard-first app; no typed-confirmation tier for the TRUNCATE/DROP class coming in v0.4; Enter activates whatever's focused with no visual default-button ring beyond autoFocus on Cancel.

gaps.title: Empty states are dead ends
gaps.detail: main-empty 'Pick a connection from the rail.' and sb-empty 'Select a connection' (App.tsx:227,249) have no clickable CTA, no ⌘K hint, no recent-connections shortcut. First-run and post-disconnect moments teach nothing about the keyboard-first model.

gaps.title: prefers-reduced-motion ignored
gaps.detail: [known — ROADMAP perf track] springs.ts presets applied unconditionally; no matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') guard. Also panelIn replays on every home↔work swap [known]. Accessibility + feel.

gaps.title: Shortcut matching is keyboard-layout dependent
gaps.detail: App.tsx:107+ matches e.key.toLowerCase() — on Cyrillic/Hebrew/Greek layouts e.key is the localized char so ⌘T/⌘W/⌘K silently die. Use e.code (KeyT) for letter chords, or let the native menu bar (P0 item) own accelerators which macOS localizes correctly.

perf_risks: App.tsx broad zustand selectors (activeTab object identity, inspectorWidth) re-render the ENTIRE shell tree — TabBar, grid subtree, sidebar — on every editor keystroke and every inspector-drag mousemove; the single biggest shell-side threat to the <16ms budget with a large grid mounted (App.tsx:50-52 + tabs.ts:231-241)
Inspector drag writes localStorage synchronously per mousemove via zustand persist (inspector.ts:40 setWidth → persist middleware serializes on every set)

Palette renders + cmdk-scores up to 400 table Command.Items (plus history/actions) on every keystroke; unbounded if the 400-slice is removed naively — needs pre-filter + capped render (Palette.tsx:208); history invoke fires every 120ms pause while typing

applyTheme does ~40 individual style.setProperty calls per palette/mode change [known — batch into one cssText write], and the editor fully remounts on theme change [known], so theme switching double-pays
noAutocorrect MutationObserver runs matches()+querySelectorAll over every inserted subtree — virtualized grid row churn during 60fps scroll makes this per-frame selector work (noAutocorrect.ts:29-39)

tabs persist() re-serializes EVERY query tab's full SQL over IPC on each 600ms pause — grows linearly with tab count × SQL size (tabs.ts:44-56); closedStack (20 full SQL bodies) lives only in memory but rides every set

escStack is O(1) and capture-phase — good; but every AnchoredOverlay/Modal mount pays a portal + layout-measure (useClampedPosition useLayoutEffect) which re-runs on point identity change — fine now, watch if menus become hover-follow
motion springs on panelIn replay on every home↔work layout swap re-animating the whole main card [known — ROADMAP perf track]
